panels.description: the current state of the spacecraft

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["subsystem"] == "CDH")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "SC_STATE")

  r["_field"]  ==  "RF_LDO_OUTPUT_VOLTAGE" or
  r["_field"]  ==  "GPS_VOLTAGE" or
